description: Lignes équipées de KVB is a dataset listed in SNCF Open Data, an open data portal of a railway operator, published or maintained by SNCF. Lignes du Réseau Ferré National équipées de KVB (contrôle de vitesse par balise). Ce fichier liste les portions de ligne équipées de contrôle de vitesse par balise. Les coordonnées géographiques sont une conversion des coordonnées ferroviaires en Lambert 93 et en WGS84 (EPSG:3857). date de mise à jour 26/02/2026. Coverage: France. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal files it under Réseau. Its keywords are SNCF RESEAU, Lignes, Infrastructure, KVB, Géolocalisation. The portal shows 2022-03-24 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Open Database License (ODbL) (https://data.sncf.com/pages/licence). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support network planning and operations studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-sncf-open-data-portal.
